protocol.selection: Use exogenous diagnostics only. First qualifying unused original seeds in ascending order; if missing, first unused seed with Phase1.2 scaled copy. Freeze before full reference characterization. No replacement after outcomes.
protocol.feasible_definition: sum ceil(bytes/capacity_per_prb_tick) <=54; positive static rates; periodic one-ms arrivals; from-empty one-tick certificate.
protocol.contested_definition: Due-work demand over first 1249-ms ON window exceeds baseline 54*ticks, but one-tick integer demand <=72 and fluid demand <60. Baseline impossibility and optimistic full-pool constructive capacity certificate.
protocol.overloaded_definition: Due-work demand even over a 1250-ms OFF/no-jam window exceeds 78*ticks; impossibility despite optimistic entire reserve to URLLC.
protocol.fallback: Only if original seeds lack a regime. Reuse Phase1.2 length-column scaling on a generated copy, never overwrite source CSVs. Preserve all timestamps, periodicity, channels and budgets.
protocol.reference_gate: Feasible: B0/B1/B2 zero known failures. Contested: >=1 percentage-point aggregate or worst-UE separation among references, or different recovery outcomes. Overloaded: positive full-pool necessary-bound deficit and observed known failures. Do not replace failed-gate held-out candidates; report not-ready.
protocol.scope: 72 short exogenous probes, freeze 18 placement seeds / 54 scenario configs, characterize 162 paired reference episodes. No model creation, checkpoint loading, optimizer updates, DQN evaluation or training.
protocol.seed_blocks_meaning: Candidate indices; actual scenario_seed = index * 4096. Legacy per-UE seed formula is unchanged.
protocol.retirement: v1 adjacent-seed discovery retired due to source-level stream overlap, not controller outcomes. No v1 memberships or results are used for future learning.
